html:
Wisijsa, or Visisa, was an Aymara-speaking lordship in the highlands of southern Bolivia, between Potosí and Chuquisaca. It belonged to the federation of Charcas, together with the Qhara Qhara and Charka, which the Inca ruled and used as soldiers in the late 1400s.

Under Spanish rule its people were drafted for the silver mines of Potosí. Its ayllus, kin-based communities holding land in common, survived. Today Wisijsa is one of the Indigenous nations of the Bolivian highlands represented in the council of Aymara and Quechua ayllus.
